note: EV SIGHTINGS - PAPER STUDY, MEASUREMENT ONLY. Never bets, never pushed. Triggers: A = best after-fee cost >= 2c under the median after-fee cost of the other books at the same line, >= $250 at the best price (qualifying >= 3c); B = best gettable (>= $250) after-fee cost beats Pinnacle no-vig fair at the same line by >= 3% EV. One record per trigger/game/market/line/side (first sighting; last_seen/scans_seen while it persists). Costs are 0-1 per $1 payout after fees (Kalshi 0.07 and Polymarket US 0.0695 x P x (1-P) taker; ProphetX 2% of winnings; Novig none). depth_usd = $ bettable at that book's best price. ref_age_s = exchange read time - Pinnacle market last_update. Close = last pregame read (close_mins_before_start); close_consensus_fair = median of books' no-vig mids; pin_close_fair = sharp_monitor.close_prob at the sighting's number (pin_close_same_line false = half points priced in). clv_*_c = (close fair - sighting_cost_af) x 100. result/units_flat = ESPN final, flat 1u at sighting_cost_af. crossed = that book's two sides cost < 97c total (stale/crossed quote).
